onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/smoothing.schema.json, set cam_c_smoothing_preset to {{cam_c_smoothing_preset}}]
Set camera smoothing to {{cam_c_smoothing_preset}}. Snappy=rotationSpeed 12, translationSpeed 10. Balanced=8,5. Cinematic=3,2.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/smoothing.schema.json, set cam_t_translation_speed to {{cam_t_translation_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.translationSpeed to {{cam_t_translation_speed}}. Higher = camera follows player position faster. Current: rotation_speed={{cam_t_rotation_speed}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/smoothing.schema.json, set cam_t_rotation_speed to {{cam_t_rotation_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.rotationSpeed to {{cam_t_rotation_speed}}. Higher = camera yaw/pitch snaps faster. Current: translation_speed={{cam_t_translation_speed}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/smoothing.schema.json, set cam_t_sensitivity to {{cam_t_sensitivity}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.mouseSensitivity to {{cam_t_sensitivity}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/smoothing.schema.json, set cam_t_default_pitch to {{cam_t_default_pitch}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.defaultPitch to {{cam_t_default_pitch}} degrees. Negative = looking slightly down.
